display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 从零重训 Packet U-Net 与 DURA 组合恢复器
description: 同一套可微复 IQ 结构，分别从零训练学习先验、接收作用和噪声估计，再经两步软观测一致性求解。保留冻结直通、原 DURA、同一新模型求解前读出和求解后读出。
authorization: 用户明确要求重新训练，保留现有两数据集 Phase1 闭集 source-only 协议。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI PyTorch CUDA FP32, separate CPU scorer

data.dataset: IEEE DataPort multi-receiver LoRa and WiSig/ManySig Main split
data.version: lora_full_packets_v1; WiSig registered R17/WiSig Main source cache
data.representation: LoRa complex 8192 at 1 MS/s -> original W24. WiSig complex 256 -> original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
data.contract_ref: LoRa parent frozen source contract.json; WiSig 20261019-phase1-reception-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m6-r02/cache/complete.json
data.physical_ids_ref: LoRa established 300 Full source V panel; WiSig 1800 existing validation_full/physical_ids.npy IDs
data.label_map_ref: Original frozen E104 (10) and WiSig Main seed 2026092701 (6); independent scorer only.
data.validation_ref: Reuse registered validates-once source handles and fixed physical panels.
data.leo_config_ref: In both datasets, existing source Full practical six and clean; WiSig uses cache, LoRa exact source_receive replay.

permissions.claim_scope: Both fits use only their own TX-hidden source U_s IQ, no existing F or G weights in fit, no seed/trace from practical or target. Read frozen F only in separate post-fit prediction.

checkpoint.initialization: Both datasets start from fresh random Packet U-Net and identity-initialized observation head; no ancestor weights loaded in fit.

sources.role: Frozen same-panel LoRa direct and R17 comparator predictions; no weights reused in fit
Frozen same-panel WiSig direct/R69 comparator predictions; no weights reused in fit
Frozen LoRa W24 E104 post-fit evaluation only
Frozen WiSig Main seed 2026092701 post-fit evaluation only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Same dataset registered source handles and original source panel IDs, separate fit and frozen prediction workers.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: No inherited recovery weights. Same already-validated frozen controls as replay.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Final 1500-step independent fits only. Joint post-solve must exceed every same-row comparator in six-scene total and match best low urban and clean on both data sets. First source-only falsification; formal expansion also requires evidence vs frozen historical strongest recovery.

execution.launch_owner: Current Codex chat, requested source retraining on both datasets
execution.gpu_policy: N607 priority 7/2/6/0/3/5/1/4, at least 12288 MiB available, one worker on each of two distinct GPUs. Other owners untouched.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on illegal or mismatched data/weights, failed no-query smoke, finite check, missing prediction or systemic launch failure. Preserve all partial artifacts, no target access.

rows.method: From-scratch Packet U-Net and learned receive action + two CG updates
rows.seed_notes: Separate from-scratch parameter state per dataset. Fit uses fixed TX-hidden U_s. No support. Existing fixed WiSig source panel has no new evaluation seed; LoRa uses panel seed 2026112559.
rows.command: python -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.packet_dura_retrain fit <runtime.json> lora; separate frozen predict then score

rows.method: From-scratch Packet U-Net and learned receive action + two CG updates
rows.seed_notes: Separate from-scratch parameter state per dataset. Fit uses fixed TX-hidden U_s. No support. Existing fixed WiSig source panel has no new evaluation seed; LoRa uses panel seed 2026112559.
rows.command: python -m experiments.pamf_lora_main.packet_dura_retrain fit <runtime.json> wisig; separate frozen predict then score

notes: Each new model consumes only its own source U_s IQ. LoRa 8192 = 8×1024, WiSig 256 = 8×32. Both use same model topology with grid-specific position embedding length.

The neural prior predicts a bounded complex residual. The learned action estimates 16 complex FIR taps, phase/drift, conjugate image, and a packet noise variance. DURA computes two CG iterations with a 0.02 variance floor and caps the extra IQ edit at half of the prior edit RMS.

Generic echoes, phase drift, conjugate image, white noise and identity fidelity are paired on source IQ. No practical traces or simulated oracle state are supplied. Variance has a residual calibration term and is detached inside the restoration solve.

Compare post-solve with pre-solve from the same trained checkpoint to isolate the deployment effect of the solve; this is not a separately trained neural-only ablation. Historical frozen controls r03 and r02 are same-panel.
